top_themes.theme: Bavarian Nordic modtager Europa-Kommissionens godkendelse af mpox/koppevaccine til børn i alderen 2 til under 12 år
top_themes.mechanism: KØBENHAVN, Danmark, 7. august 2026 – Bavarian Nordic A/S (OMX: BAVA) meddelte i dag, at Europa-Kommissionen, på baggrund af den nylige positive udtalelse fra Udvalget for Humanmedicinske Lægemidler (CHMP), nu har godkendt en type II-ændring for koppe- og mpoxvaccinen IMVANEX® (MVA-BN). Dermed udvides den eksisterende markedsføringstilladelse til at omfatte børn i alderen 2 til under 12 år.

top_themes.theme: Bavarian Nordic Receives European Commission Approval of Mpox/Smallpox Vaccine for Children Aged 2 to Less than 12 Years
top_themes.mechanism: COPENHAGEN, Denmark, August 7, 2026 – Bavarian Nordic A/S (OMX: BAVA) announced today that the European Commission has adopted the recent Committee for Medicinal Products for Human Use (CHMP) positive opinion recommending the approval of a type II variation for IMVANEX® (MVA-BN) smallpox and mpox vaccine, extending the current marketing authorization to include children 2 to less than 12 years of age.
